title: Double the frequency of 500-D on the Outer Ring Road
description: 500-D (route 1066, Central Silk Board - Hebbala Bridge) is the main ORR trunk variant: 44 of the 68 trips on the 15 route ids numbered 500-D that leave their first stop between 07:30 and 09:30 (69 of its trips run during that window). Its timetable is irregular (mostly 5 min at peak, 10-140 min gaps off-peak), so frequency is scaled, not reset to a fixed headway.
expected_change: Gains only, no zone loses. Small: 500-D already runs about every 5 min in the AM window, so halving the headway saves about 1-1.5 min of waiting. Gains sit in zones along the ORR from Central Silk Board through Bellandur, Marathahalli and KR Pura to Hebbal.
